meaning_en: to ventilate / diffuse refreshing airflow throughout a home

past.ar: رَوَّحَ مَجْرَى الهَوَاءِ رُبُوعَ الدَّارِ الكَبِيرَةِ
past.de: Der Luftzug erfrischte die Räume des großen Hauses
past.en: The air current ventilated the halls of the great house

present.ar: يُرَوِّحُ الفِنَاءَ بِلَا صَوْتٍ وَلَا عَنَاءٍ
present.de: Er lüftet den Innenhof lautlos und ohne Mühe
present.en: It ventilates the courtyard silently and effortlessly

imperative.en: Ventilate the dwellers with cool relief!
